summary: Context rotation and cross-session delivery: restore RFC-0058 (module rotates as code, $.session.send only, no pane typing, no false-success socket send)

options.description: Restore RFC-0058: each session's hooks module rotates itself as code (handoff write via $.process.run, then $.command.run clear); cross-session messages only via $.session.send; cli-hierarchy send stops raw socket writes and reports failure; add a rotation log and a delivery receipt surfaced in status; delete pane typing for rotation once module rotation is proven in real runs (DEC-0415)
Keep tmux pane /clear (AISDLC-1107), land dialog deferral (#3150), make cli-hierarchy send fail loudly
Module rotation first; dispatch types /clear only after N minutes with no logged rotation and no pending question, each fallback escalated
Delete automatic rotation; Stop hook warns and sessions clear only on operator word or the handoff routine

body: Problem: rotation clears sessions by typing into tmux panes (AISDLC-1107), which reached the enterprise planner as operator input on 2026-11-27 (AISDLC-1464) and can press Enter in an open dialog; cli-hierarchy send writes a raw line to the harness socket (send.ts:105-112), which the harness drops while the CLI prints ok, and no health check tests delivery (send-resolve.ts:61-82 checks pid, procStart and file existence only). Applies DEC-0415 (finish-migration: delete a typed path only after its Mods replacement is proven in real runs) to rotation and delivery. Options put to the operator through the decision rubric on 2026-11-27; recorded by the planner.
